summary_for_children: Al-Inshiqaq speaks of the sky splitting in words, and swears by the twilight, the night and the full moon.
environment_concept: Evening: a band of twilight glow lingers on the horizon (84:16) as night gathers (84:17), and a large full moon rises (84:18). A row of eight stone discs shows the moon's phases, state after state (84:19). The splitting of the sky and the Day (84:1-15) are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A low twilight glow on the horizon, a large rising full moon, a row of carved moon-phase stones, a bench.
